title: Robinhood Misses Q3 Earnings as Crypto Revenue Rises and Prediction Market Bets Grow
summary: Robinhood posted record revenue of $1.42 billion but earned $0.51 per share, short of the $0.55 expected, as bets on sports and elections grew to $173 million and crypto edged up.

title: Robinhood Taps Ripple's Stablecoin, Treasury Software and Trading Loans
summary: Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin is live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp, and heads to the Robinhood app later this year as the companies deepen ties in treasury and institutional trading.

title: Anchorage Positions Itself as Custody Backbone of US-Mexico Stablecoin Corridor
summary: An expanded deal with Bitso puts Anchorage Digital Bank’s custody beneath both sides of the US-Mexico remittance route.

title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Keystone Pulls Devices as Stolen Key Opens Door to Fakes
summary: Attackers obtained the factory key that proves Keystone's hardware wallets are genuine, and 25,964 buyer records were affected. The company says recovery phrases and private keys were not involved.

title: Circle Pushes Deeper Into Latin America With USDC Settlement in Colombia
summary: A collaboration with payments-tech firm ACI Worldwide will pilot folding USDC settlement into Colombia’s instant-payments network.

title: OpenAI Proves ETH Is False, and Crypto Twitter Has Questions
summary: A new OpenAI paper declares ETH false, a claim that hundreds of research papers lean on. Crypto Twitter degens and serious mathematicians are abuzz.

title: McDonald's McRib Doesn't Actually Boost Bitcoin's Price, Sorry Everyone
summary: Crypto traders think the McRib’s return to McDonald's means a Bitcoin pump is coming. Experts say there is "no correlation at all."

title: Polymarket Has Investigated 'Dozens' of Midterm Election Bets: Report
summary: The firm's new head of investigations says its surveillance system flags hundreds of alerts a day, with at least two cases sent to the CFTC.

title: Bitcoin Mining Firm Luxor Raises $16 Million to Scale Its AI Compute Push
summary: The CMT Digital-led round, which drew mining-hardware makers Canaan and MicroBT, will fund Luxor’s expansion into AI compute trading, hardware and derivatives.

title: Morning Minute: Tokenized Stock Battle Looms Over Robinhood’s Earnings Call
summary: One of crypto’s primary growth sectors for this upcoming cycle is under attack. Will Vlad Tenev speak up on today’s Robinhood earnings call?

title: Why This Team of Ninjas Is Tripling Down on Mining Bitcoin
summary: NIP Group says Bitcoin mining has “earned its place” as the esports giant swaps 247 million shares for more machines.

title: Ripple Wins Final OCC Approval for Trust Bank Behind $2.6B RLUSD Stablecoin
summary: The federally supervised bank will manage RLUSD's reserves and offer custody, as banking groups fight crypto charters in court.

title: Canada’s Draft Stablecoin Rules Cap Redemption Fees at 1% and Ban Yield
summary: Ottawa opened a 60-day consultation on draft rules requiring one-to-one reserves and fast redemption from stablecoin issuers, while keeping the ban on paying holders interest.

title: NBA Embraces the CFTC on Prediction Markets as the NFL Fights It in Court
summary: The agreement, which follows similar deals with MLB and NHL, establishes information-sharing to guard against insider trading as sports betting migrates to CFTC-regulated venues.

title: Bitcoin Wallet Fixes Critical Flaw That Redirected Funds to Attackers
summary: A confirmed exploit let rogue servers replace Electrum’s pending transactions, tricking users into redirecting Bitcoin to attacker addresses.

title: India’s CoinDCX Confirms $16 Million Loss Days After CEO Called It a ‘False Alarm’
summary: The Mumbai-based exchange says 15.99 million USDT was drained from wallets it retired after last year’s $44 million hack, bringing its combined losses to nearly $60 million—and it’s absorbing the hit.

title: Brazil’s Stock Market Crashes After Lula’s Upset Victory
summary: The iShares Brazil ETF fell as much as 26% after Lula da Silva beat Flávio Bolsonaro, who prediction markets had at 80%, while the dollar jumped as much as 12% against the real.

title: Tom Lee's Bitmine Keeps Buying Ethereum But Pivots to Record Share Buybacks
summary: The firm added 10,452 ETH to reach 4.95% of supply, but its bigger move was repurchasing 2.04 million of its own shares—part of what it calls the largest equity buyback any crypto treasury company has run.
